THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Coffee Toffee Creami

Decaf coffee and English toffee Ninja Creami: 1/2 tbsp decaf instant coffee blended into the Nurri 2% and whey isolate base, then 15g HEATH chocolatey English toffee bits mixed in on Respin. About 300 calories and 34g protein for the whole finished pint.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME24 hr freeze + 5 min rest + spin
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~300 cal | ~34g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: All 15g of HEATH chocolatey English toffee bits go into the post-spin Respin cycle without adding liquid; no additional topping is used.

Ingredients

BASE

  • 1 cup (240ml) Nurri plain 2% ultra-filtered milk
  • 1/2 labeled serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate (60 calories / 14g protein)
  • 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum, leveled
  • Pinch of salt
  • 1/2 tbsp decaf instant coffee (Nescafé Taster’s Choice Decaf House Blend used)

MIX-IN

  • 15g HEATH chocolatey English toffee bits (no additional topping)

Allergens: dairy, almonds, soy.

You want a rich coffee-and-toffee ice cream pint at night using decaf instant coffee and real HEATH English toffee bits for ~300 calories and 34g protein across the whole pint.

Method

  1. 1.ADD COFFEE BASE INGREDIENTS. Combine 1 cup Nurri plain 2% milk, 1/2 serving unflavored whey isolate, 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener, 1/8 tsp leveled guar gum, a pinch of salt, and 1/2 tbsp decaf instant coffee in a Creami pint.
  2. 2.BLEND & FREEZE 24H. Blend all base ingredients until smooth, respecting the pint fill line. Freeze upright and level for 24 hours.
  3. 3.FIRST SPIN & ADD 15G TOFFEE BITS. Rest the pint on the counter for 5 minutes, then process on Regular Ice Cream. Add all 15g HEATH chocolatey English toffee bits into the center well.
  4. 4.RESPIN & SERVE. Run Respin without adding liquid so the toffee bits fold evenly through the pint. Serve immediately.

Keys to success

  • Decaf instant coffee reduces caffeine compared to regular instant coffee, though decaf is not a zero-caffeine claim.
  • Total carbohydrate before the sweetener’s sugar alcohols is approximately 15g (14–16g range); total label carbs depend on the specific monk-fruit/erythritol brand and weight.

Storage and reheating

Store: Freeze the blended coffee base upright and level for up to 1 week. Spin and mix in the 15g HEATH toffee bits when ready to eat.

Reheat: Do not heat the pint.

Lasts: Unspun frozen pint keeps 1 week; enjoy immediately after Respin.

Estimated nutrition

~300 cal | ~34g protein per 1 whole finished Creami pint (with 15g HEATH toffee bits).

Label-based whole-pint estimate is ~291–298.5 calories, 34g protein, and 10g fat, displayed as ≈300 calories and 34g protein for the entire finished pint. Breakdown: 1 cup Nurri plain 2% milk (150 cal, 20g protein, 5g carbs, 5g fat) + 1/2 serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate (60 cal, 14g protein, 0g carbs, 0g fat) + 15g HEATH chocolatey English toffee bits (80 cal, 0g protein, 9g carbs, 5g fat) + 1/2 tbsp / 1.5 tsp decaf instant coffee (0–7.5 cal allowance) + sweetener/guar/salt (1 cal). Approximately 15g carbohydrate before the sweetener’s sugar alcohols.
